persons.name: Pūrṇānanda
persons.evidence: pūrṇānandeti nāmā samalikhad amalaṃ bhadrakalpāvadānaṃ ... śrīpūrṇānandana thavata coyā jula

date.as_written: nepāle saṃvadākhye kunavanavayute śrāvaṇē śuklapakṣe || paṃcamyāṃ vaiśvadeve parighakasahite bhānuputrasya vāre / saṃvat 991 śrāvaṇamāsayā paṃcami(!) utra(!)bhādranakṣakra(!) parighanayoga(!) śanivāra

notes: The chronogram 'kunavanavayute' yields 991 (ku=1, nava=9, nava=9, read backwards). The Newari phrase 'thavata coyā jula' indicates the scribe copied the manuscript for himself.
